description_excerpt: Job Description Get to Know the Team GIP stands for Growth, Insights & Planning. In Vietnam, it operates as a central business team that partners with functions such as Mobility, Commercial, Marketing, Marketplace and other operational teams to identify growth opportunities, provide data-driven insights and support business planning.
